import itertools
import string
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func():
    alphabet = string.ascii_lowercase

    # Generate all 3-letter combinations
    combinations = itertools.product(alphabet, repeat=3)

    # Build DataFrame
    df = pd.DataFrame(combinations, columns=["letter1", "letter2", "letter3"])

    # Count frequency of first letters
    first_letter_counts = (
        df["letter1"]
        .value_counts()
        .reindex(list(alphabet), fill_value=0)
    )

    # Plot histogram-like frequency chart
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(first_letter_counts.index, first_letter_counts.values)
    ax.set_xlabel("First letter")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.set_title("Frequency of First Letters in All 3-Letter Combinations")

    return df, ax
